notes: Bear cross slam in three 10-frame pieces, each played once at 20 fps from when the cross front reaches it: 0-9 a 48 px piece of a horizontal arm (flipped for the left arm), 10-19 a 48 px piece of a vertical arm (rocks rise up the screen, so the same frames serve the upper and lower arm), 20-29 the centre where the paw lands. Crack with green light, stone shards erupt and shatter, dust. Shown at 1x. Anchor = ground point under the piece. Apollo.
